gameDescriptionHtml:
Build the Great Wall, grow your village, and leave a lasting legacy in this immersive building and management simulator set in medieval China! Start your journey as a humble villager, tasked with the monumental responsibility of constructing the Great Wall. Manage your settlement, assign tasks to NPCs, and develop vital production chains to supply the resources needed for this epic endeavor. Build workshops, unlock advanced technologies, and transform your modest village into a bustling hub of activity.

Explore a World Inspired by Ancient China – Travel across three distinct biomes – majestic mountains, arid deserts, and serene river valleys – each with its own resources, challenges, and breathtaking landscapes. Unearth ancient secrets, master new building techniques, and adapt to the environment as you progress in your mission. Every region brings new opportunities to expand your skills and push the boundaries of what your settlement can achieve.
Master the Art of Building and Crafting – From hewing stone to shaping wood, use realistic step-by-step construction mechanics to create authentic structures. Build iconic landmarks, including defense towers, desert forts, and the legendary Jiankou Sky Stairs. Your efforts will not only shape the Great Wall but also develop the infrastructure of your village, with workshops for crafting bricks, smelting metals, and producing decorative elements.
Immerse Yourself in Village Life – Take on the role of both leader and craftsman. Cultivate crops, raise livestock, and gather rare ingredients to sustain your community. Cook traditional Chinese dishes, personalize your settlement with handcrafted decorations, and watch your village grow into a thriving, vibrant town. Your leadership will turn a small settlement into a cornerstone of your empire.
Rise to Glory and Shape History – As your reputation grows, advance in the social hierarchy and earn recognition from the emperor himself. Unlock new technologies, perfect your skills, and become a legendary builder whose work defines a generation. Follow the inspiring story of Jun and Mei, master craftsmen whose guidance and knowledge will lead you to success.

The Great Wall awaits. Build your legacy in Chinese Frontiers and leave your mark on history!

Game Features

  • Realistic and detailed building mechanics with step-by-step construction.
  • Manage NPC workers, gather resources, and optimize workflows in your settlement.
  • Three expansive biomes with unique challenges, resources, and mysteries to uncover.
  • A dynamic blend of building, crafting, farming, and exploration.
  • Authentic Chinese culture brought to life through architecture, cuisine, and craftsmanship.
  • A captivating story guiding your journey to build one of the greatest wonders of the world.
